notes.pranksterElo: Elo-inspired bounded index: 1500 multiplied by tournament size, placement, total tournaments, total win-rate, and recency modifiers, in that priority order. It is not pairwise Elo because Limitless standings do not include opponent-level match logs.
notes.formula: round(1500 * tournamentSizeModifier * placementModifier * totalTournamentsModifier * totalWinRateModifier * recencyModifier)
notes.modifierRanges: Tournament size 0.94-1.09, placement 0.90-1.16, total tournaments 0.87832-1.21528, total win-rate 0.9-1.16, recency 0.97-1.05.
notes.placementWeighting: Placement uses tournament-size weight, with top finishes receiving extra placement weight: top 32 1.5x, top 8 1.75x, top 2 2x, winner 2.5x.
notes.metricEligibility: Metric calculations exclude standings where the player dropped on game 1.
